categories_thin: Independent hardware - none found; the Old Bridge hardware market is Home Depot, Lowe's and Harbor Freight (all excluded chains).
Trophy / awards / engraving - searched again: the Old Bridge-area results are Edison (Joe Romer Trophy Shop, 1072 Amboy Ave) or Woodbridge businesses, none in-town with a verifiable address.
Picture framing - searched again: only Milltown (Debbie's Custom Picture Framing) and East Brunswick framing shops appeared; nothing in Old Bridge Township.

Bicycle shops - searched again and found one in-town directory record (The Original Bike Shop of Old Bridge, 991 Englishtown Rd); every other result was East Brunswick/Matawan (Planet Bike) or a big-box store, so this category is still effectively a single lead.
Independent hotels/motels - only the branded Hampton Inn is verifiable in town; the two former motel listings could not be confirmed as operating (see data_gaps) and were removed.

Party supplies - searched again: only stale or ambiguous records (Discount Party Warehouse at 1052 Route 9 in an old iBegin page, Ann's Party Supplies at 11 Jocama Blvd with no category confirmation), so none were added.
Screen printing / embroidery - only home-based or out-of-town operators appeared; home-based addresses were deliberately excluded.

Independent pharmacies - deliberately not enumerated: the brief's exclusion list names pharmacies explicitly, so the Route 516/Route 9 independents the verifier flagged (Southwood, ACE-Rx Specialty, Woodlane, Old Bridge Drugs & Surgicals, Wellness Center) are out of scope rather than missing.
Independent retail generally is thin because Route 9 retail in Old Bridge is overwhelmingly chain-anchored (Target, Kohl's, Marshalls, Five Below, Petco, Mattress Warehouse, etc.).
caveats: Scope is Old Bridge Township only, within 10 miles of central Milltown. Sayreville/Parlin addresses on Washington Road, Cherry Lane and the high-3000s and up of Bordentown Avenue were removed this round: Carmen F. Spezzi Funeral Home, Paul's Toy Room, Priscilla Jewelry, Kidzland Child Care Center and The Peace Rose Montessori School all sit in Sayreville Borough. Bordentown Avenue addresses in the low 3000s (3008, 3018, 3130, 3150) remain in zone.
One entry was moved out of zone on its own site's evidence: GMI Designs (1031 Route 18) is in East Brunswick, not Old Bridge, and was removed.

Chain rule applied to national/regional brands only. Two small multi-store New Jersey operators are kept but explicitly tagged REGIONAL CHAIN in notes: PetCenter Old Bridge and Cardsmart & Gift. If the owner wants strictly one-shop independents, those two should be dropped.

Pharmacies are on the brief's exclusion list, so the independent pharmacy cluster on Route 516/Route 9 was not added even though the verifier asked for a scope decision. If the owner treats independents differently from chains, five more entries could be added.
Old Bridge Columbian Club is kept but labelled as a Knights of Columbus fraternal hall; its promoted events date to 2021, so current booking activity is unproven.
Good Shepherd Children's Center is kept as a child-care business with its church affiliation recorded in notes (its site links to the parent congregation gs4nj.org).
Route 34 addresses here are Old Bridge Township despite Matawan mailing addresses, so Old Bridge School of Dance, Matawan Montessori Academy and BridgeLife Thrift are correctly in zone.
Laurence Harbor (08879) is at roughly the 10-mile boundary from central Milltown; its one business is marked for radius re-check.
Home-based businesses (photographers and embroiderers found at residential street addresses) were excluded to respect the no-home-address rule; this modestly reduces completeness.

Entries marked 'one directory only', 'one bulk directory only' or 'one directory index only' come from bulk directory records and have not been confirmed by a second source; the triage team should verify them.

National chains and franchise locations identified and deliberately excluded include Target, Kohl's, Marshalls, Five Below, Dollar Tree, Petco, Sally Beauty, Mattress Warehouse, Sleep Number, Ashley-type chains, Hampton Inn, KinderCare, Goddard School, Primrose, Lightbridge Academy, The Learning Experience, Montessori Kids Universe, Kumon, H&R Block, The UPS Store, FedEx Office and Woof Gang Bakery.
data_gaps: Removed for lack of confirmation, not because they are known to be closed: Circle Motor Lodge (1 Victory Ct) and Desi Inn (39 Thomas St) rest on Yellow Pages category pages with no hours, reviews, website or booking page; Happy Home Appliances, whose Old Bridge address is contradicted by its own site showing Sayreville; Best Home Furnishings, where the address is now a Dollar Tree per the town directory; Ink'd Greetings, which had only a Google Maps search URL and an Arizona phone; Forman Industries, which had no address, phone or trade.

Old Bridge Village Grooming (170 Jake Brown Rd) was dropped: the only corroboration was one directory page, and the same address appears as a residential real-estate listing, so it may be a home-based business.

Aarius Studios (4420 Bordentown Ave #4) was NOT added: one bulk directory classifies it as a contractor while a music-business directory and a musician's account place a recording studio there and report it closed. Conflicting and unconfirmed.

Five independent pharmacies the verifier named (Southwood, ACE-Rx Specialty, Woodlane, Old Bridge Drugs & Surgicals, Wellness Center) were not enumerated because pharmacies are an excluded category - not because they do not exist.

No complete industrial tenant census. The Central 9 Logistics Park buildings on Jake Brown Road / Fairway Lane and the Jocama Boulevard / Nicholas Drive / Perrine Road business parks are only partly captured; most tenants there are large nationals or could not be tied to a verified suite address.
Child care coverage relies on the state licensed-centre list; licensed family child care homes and license-exempt religious programs are not in it and were not enumerated.

Several directory-only entries need confirmation via a call or map check: In Style Furniture, Magic Years Nursery School, Collectors Coins & Jewelry, Bright Signs, Artworks360, Poker Industries, Academy of Music In Old Bridge, Evergreen Production, The Original Bike Shop of Old Bridge, Tackle U.S.
No reliable source listed Old Bridge manufacturers by SIC; the manufacturer list is therefore opportunistic and almost certainly incomplete.

Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta (partly), D&B and OpenStreetMap/Overpass endpoints blocked automated access, so several bulk directories could only be used through search-result snippets. Google Maps was used only through search URLs, which the verifier cannot re-open, so every entry that cited one now also cites a re-openable page.
Awning, upholstery, locksmith, appliance-parts and small machine shops on the Route 9 / Texas Road corridors were only partly enumerated.
